branches.title: Auction yards
branches.description: AUCT yards to read. Pattaya, Chonburi, Rayong, Bangkok and Rangsit by default.

daysAhead.title: Days ahead
daysAhead.description: Auctions from today to this many days ahead.

pastDays.title: Sold prices from the last days
pastDays.description: Also read the prices cars were sold for at AUCT auctions in this many past days (all yards), for the reference price. 0 skips it.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: Only these brands, for example Toyota, Honda, Isuzu. Empty for all.

keywords.title: Models
keywords.description: Only cars whose model contains one of these words, for example Fortuner, Yaris, City, D-Max. Empty for all models.

maxMileage.title: Max mileage (km)
maxMileage.description: Skip cars with more kilometres than this.

carGroups.title: AUCT groups
carGroups.description: G: normal cars (also repaired flood cars). U: cannot be driven, sold as is. I: transfer of ownership not guaranteed. W: flooded, not repaired. S: salvage. G only for cars to use right away.

minBodyStars.title: Body: at least (stars)
minBodyStars.description: AUCT's 1–5 stars. Engine: 3 = average, 2 = needs repair, 1 = must be repaired before use. Body: 2 or 1 = heavy collision reaching the main structure.

minEngineStars.title: Engine: at least (stars)
minEngineStars.description: AUCT's 1–5 stars. Engine: 3 = average, 2 = needs repair, 1 = must be repaired before use. Body: 2 or 1 = heavy collision reaching the main structure.

minInteriorStars.title: Interior: at least (stars)
minInteriorStars.description: AUCT's 1–5 stars. Engine: 3 = average, 2 = needs repair, 1 = must be repaired before use. Body: 2 or 1 = heavy collision reaching the main structure.

minPrice.title: Min price (THB)
minPrice.description: Skip cars expected to sell below this (the starting price is used when no sales are known).

maxPrice.title: Max price (THB)
maxPrice.description: Skip cars expected to sell above this (the starting price is used when no sales are known).

noPickups.title: No pickups or vans
noPickups.description: Skip pickups and vans (AUCT body group กระบะ & ตู้, and models such as D-Max, Triton, Hilux, Ranger, Navara).

targets.title: My price targets
targets.description: One car per line: words of the model, an optional year and the most you would pay, for example toyota fortuner 2020 750000 or honda city 450000. A car fits when what the same model and year sold for at AUCT (median) is at or under your price.

onlyTargets.title: Only cars within my targets
onlyTargets.description: Save only the cars that fit one of your targets.

historyName.title: History store
historyName.description: Named key-value store with the prices of earlier runs, used for the reference price.

delayMs.title: Pause between requests (ms)
delayMs.description: The Actor reads one page at a time with this pause.

retailReference.title: Compare with retail prices (Carsome)
retailReference.description: Read the cars on sale at Carsome (refreshed weekly) and show how far the expected auction price is below retail for the same model and year.

retailRefreshDays.title: Refresh retail prices every (days)
retailRefreshDays.description: Carsome prices older than this are read again; in between, the saved ones are used.
